_note: SOURCED — fetched directly from the actual Telangana SCERT 'Diploma in Elementary Education (D.El.Ed.) Two-Year Programme, Curriculum & Syllabus 2015' (based on NCTE norms). This resolves the mismatch flagged in pedagogy-of-mathematics.json (bed-2yr): D.El.Ed, not B.Ed, is the program that actually trains teachers for grades 1-5 mathematics, and its 1st-Year Paper 5 ('Understanding Mathematics and Early Mathematics Education at Primary Level') Unit 3 ('Counting, Numbers and its Operations') explicitly lists 'Concept of fractions and its presentation' as a bullet point — a direct, confirmed match for the fraction LearningComponents, not an inferred one. Note this is the Telangana-specific D.El.Ed syllabus (other states run their own D.El.Ed variants under the same NCTE norms), and it is dated 2015 — pre-dates NCF-SE 2023, so re-verify against any post-2023 syllabus revision before treating as current.
